C9000287.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 287 (Isomorphism of the free group factors.; papers: An isomorphism of the free group factors; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/287.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_FLOW_TRACE_IDENTITY.statement: For arbitrary finite real supports h_j, every formal polynomial p and integer r >= 1, tau(ev_0(delta^r p)) = 0.

L_FLOW_LABELS.statement: Nonidentity-label monomials have zero initial trace; delta preserves the label; identity-label monomials rewrite in the z_g.

L_FLOW_CONJUGATES.statement: The initial conjugate algebras A_g W*(S) A_g* are freely independent, including grouping a component's complement.

L_FLOW_PARTIAL_TRACE.statement: A partial inner derivation on one free component, implemented in its free complement, annihilates the trace of every polynomial.

L_FLOW_ALGEBRA_CORE.statement: For every finite word, complementary partial commutator insertions sum to the full inner commutator; a tracial linear functional vanishing on complementary insertions vanishes on the selected insertions.

L_FLOW_ITERATION.statement: A linear functional annihilating the range of a polynomial endomorphism annihilates all positive iterates.

L_FLOW_GLOBAL.statement: The finite polynomial vector field with bounded fixed S has a unique global norm-smooth solution from each unitary tuple, remaining unitary.

L_FLOW_ANALYTIC_BOUND.statement: For each fixed formal polynomial, finite substitution growth and unitarity give a uniform factorial derivative bound and a positive Taylor radius at every real time.

C_FLOW_MOMENTS.statement: The actual global unitary solution has the same initial joint polynomial moments for every real time.

C_FLOW_HEADLINE_REMAINDER.statement: The small-cocycle, adaptive-generation and rank-step arguments also hold and yield the manuscript's consecutive-rank isomorphisms; these are outside this mission.
